settings.heading: Sell your statues
settings.body: Email photos and details of the statues you’d like to sell. We’ll let you know if we can make an offer.

settings.title: Identify the statue
settings.text: Include the character, studio, scale if known and your UK town or postcode.

settings.title: Tell us about its condition
settings.text: Mention any chips, repairs or missing parts. Tell us whether you have the original box and inserts.

settings.title: Send clear photos
settings.text: Show the front, sides, base and any damage.

settings.title: Get a reply by email
settings.text: We buy statues directly. If we can make an offer, we’ll explain the price and how handover would work.

settings.label: Original packaging
settings.hint: Box and inserts, yes or no

settings.heading: Use the enquiry form
settings.body: Start with the details below. You can email photos separately.
settings.message_label: Tell us about the piece or collection
settings.message_hint: Include your location and any condition details we should know about.
settings.photo_note: Email photos to sultan@sultanofstatues.com using the same email address so we can match them to your enquiry.
settings.success: Thank you. Your enquiry has been sent. We will reply by email.
